dialogues.speaker: Local
dialogues.en: Beautiful day, isn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Tourist
dialogues.en: It really is. I've been lucky with the weather all week.
dialogues.ko: 정말 그러네요. 이번 주 내내 날씨 운이 좋았어요.

dialogues.speaker: Local
dialogues.en: Are you here on holiday?

dialogues.speaker: Tourist
dialogues.en: Yes, my first time in this city. I arrived on Monday.
dialogues.ko: 네, 이 도시는 처음이에요. 월요일에 도착했습니다.

dialogues.speaker: Local
dialogues.en: I'm Daniel, by the way.

dialogues.speaker: Tourist
dialogues.en: Nice to meet you, Daniel. I'm Mina.

dialogues.speaker: Local
dialogues.en: Mina. Did I say that right?

dialogues.speaker: Tourist
dialogues.en: That's perfect. Most people find it easy to say.

dialogues.speaker: Local
dialogues.en: What brings you all this way?

dialogues.speaker: Tourist
dialogues.en: I saved up for a proper holiday. I work in Seoul as a designer.
dialogues.ko: 제대로 된 휴가를 위해 돈을 모았어요. 서울에서 디자이너로 일합니다.

dialogues.speaker: Local
dialogues.en: That sounds like a good job. Do you get much time off?

dialogues.speaker: Tourist
dialogues.en: Not often, so I'm making the most of these two weeks.

dialogues.speaker: Local
dialogues.en: Well, I should let you get on with your day.

dialogues.speaker: Tourist
dialogues.en: It was nice talking to you. Any tips before I go?
dialogues.ko: 이야기 나눠서 좋았어요. 가기 전에 팁 하나만 주실래요?

dialogues.speaker: Local
dialogues.en: Skip the tourist street and eat where the queue is local.
dialogues.ko: 관광객 거리는 건너뛰고 현지인이 줄 서는 곳에서 드세요.

dialogues.speaker: Tourist
dialogues.en: I'll do that. Thanks, Daniel. Enjoy your afternoon.
dialogues.ko: 그럴게요. 고마워요, 다니엘. 좋은 오후 보내세요.

scenarios.title: 어디서 오셨어요 (Where Are You From)
scenarios.subtitle: 출신 소개, 한국 이야기, 문화 차이

dialogues.speaker: Local
dialogues.en: Where are you from, if you don't mind me asking?

dialogues.speaker: Tourist
dialogues.en: Not at all. I'm from South Korea, from Seoul.

dialogues.speaker: Local
dialogues.en: I've always wanted to go. Is it as busy as they say?
dialogues.ko: 늘 가보고 싶었어요. 사람들 말처럼 그렇게 복잡한가요?

dialogues.speaker: Tourist
dialogues.en: Busier, honestly. But the subway makes it easy to get around.
dialogues.ko: 솔직히 더해요. 그래도 지하철이 잘 돼 있어서 다니기는 편합니다.

dialogues.speaker: Local
dialogues.en: What should I see if I ever visit?
dialogues.ko: 혹시 가게 되면 뭘 봐야 할까요?

dialogues.speaker: Tourist
dialogues.en: Seoul for a few days, then Busan for the sea and the food.
dialogues.ko: 서울에서 며칠 있다가 부산에서 바다와 음식을 즐기세요.

dialogues.speaker: Local
dialogues.en: Is English widely spoken there?

dialogues.speaker: Tourist
dialogues.en: In the cities, enough to get by. The signs are in English too.
dialogues.ko: 도시에서는 다니는 데 충분해요. 표지판에도 영어가 있고요.

dialogues.speaker: Local
dialogues.en: Your English is really good. How long have you studied?

dialogues.speaker: Tourist
dialogues.en: Thank you. Since school, but I only started speaking recently.
dialogues.ko: 감사합니다. 학교 때부터요, 근데 말하기는 최근에 시작했어요.

dialogues.speaker: Local
dialogues.en: You'd never know. Say something in Korean for me.
dialogues.ko: 전혀 그렇게 안 보여요. 한국어로 한마디 해주세요.

dialogues.speaker: Tourist
dialogues.en: Mannaseo bangapseumnida. It means nice to meet you.

dialogues.speaker: Local
dialogues.en: What's surprised you most about being here?
dialogues.ko: 여기 와서 가장 놀란 게 뭐예요?

dialogues.speaker: Tourist
dialogues.en: How early everything closes. At home the shops stay open late.
dialogues.ko: 가게가 너무 일찍 닫는다는 거요. 한국은 늦게까지 열거든요.

dialogues.speaker: Local
dialogues.en: That's true. We eat dinner earlier than most places too.
dialogues.ko: 맞아요. 저녁도 다른 나라보다 일찍 먹는 편이에요.

dialogues.speaker: Tourist
dialogues.en: I've noticed. I keep arriving at restaurants after the rush.
dialogues.ko: 느꼈어요. 식당에 갈 때마다 붐비는 시간이 지나 있더라고요.

dialogues.speaker: Tourist
dialogues.en: Is it always this warm in October?

dialogues.speaker: Local
dialogues.en: Not usually. We've had an unusually mild autumn this year.
dialogues.ko: 보통은 아니에요. 올해는 유난히 포근한 가을이네요.

dialogues.speaker: Tourist
dialogues.en: I packed a coat I haven't touched once.
dialogues.ko: 코트를 챙겨 왔는데 한 번도 안 꺼냈어요.

dialogues.speaker: Local
dialogues.en: Keep it handy. It turns cold quickly once the wind changes.
dialogues.ko: 가까이 두세요. 바람이 바뀌면 금방 추워집니다.

dialogues.speaker: Tourist
dialogues.en: The forecast says rain all weekend. Is that reliable here?
dialogues.ko: 주말 내내 비 예보던데, 여기 예보가 잘 맞나요?

dialogues.speaker: Local
dialogues.en: Rarely. It passes in an hour most days, then the sun comes out.
dialogues.ko: 잘 안 맞아요. 대개 한 시간이면 지나가고 해가 납니다.

dialogues.speaker: Tourist
dialogues.en: Should I still carry an umbrella?
dialogues.ko: 그래도 우산을 들고 다니는 게 나을까요?

dialogues.speaker: Local
dialogues.en: A small one, yes. Or buy a cheap one at any corner shop.
dialogues.ko: 작은 걸로 하나요. 아니면 아무 편의점에서 싼 걸 사셔도 되고요.

dialogues.speaker: Local
dialogues.en: You should come back in spring when everything is in bloom.
dialogues.ko: 꽃 피는 봄에 다시 오셔야 해요.

dialogues.speaker: Tourist
dialogues.en: That's what everyone says. Is it very crowded then?

dialogues.speaker: Local
dialogues.en: Busier, but worth it. April is the best month by far.
dialogues.ko: 더 붐비지만 그만한 값은 해요. 4월이 단연 최고입니다.

dialogues.speaker: Tourist
dialogues.en: I'll remember that for next time.

dialogues.speaker: Local
dialogues.en: Have you tried the market on the corner yet?

dialogues.speaker: Tourist
dialogues.en: Not yet. Is it open on Sundays?

dialogues.speaker: Local
dialogues.en: Until two. Go early, the bread is gone by ten.

dialogues.speaker: Tourist
dialogues.en: Good to know. I'll head over tomorrow morning.

dialogues.speaker: Backpacker
dialogues.en: Have you been travelling long?

dialogues.speaker: Tourist
dialogues.en: Three weeks so far. This is my fourth city.

dialogues.speaker: Backpacker
dialogues.en: Which one has been your favourite?

dialogues.speaker: Tourist
dialogues.en: The small coastal town before this. Nobody was in a hurry there.
dialogues.ko: 여기 오기 전 작은 바닷가 마을이요. 아무도 서두르지 않더라고요.

dialogues.speaker: Backpacker
dialogues.en: I'm heading that way next. Anything I shouldn't miss?
dialogues.ko: 저도 다음에 그쪽으로 가요. 놓치면 안 되는 게 있나요?

dialogues.speaker: Tourist
dialogues.en: Take the early boat to the island. It's empty before ten.
dialogues.ko: 섬으로 가는 첫배를 타세요. 10시 전에는 사람이 없어요.

dialogues.speaker: Backpacker
dialogues.en: How long does the crossing take?

dialogues.speaker: Tourist
dialogues.en: Forty minutes, and the ride itself is worth it.

dialogues.speaker: Backpacker
dialogues.en: I got on the wrong train yesterday and ended up an hour away.
dialogues.ko: 어제 기차를 잘못 타서 한 시간 떨어진 데까지 갔어요.

dialogues.speaker: Tourist
dialogues.en: I did the same thing on my second day. Did you make it back?
dialogues.ko: 저도 둘째 날에 똑같이 그랬어요. 돌아오셨어요?

dialogues.speaker: Backpacker
dialogues.en: Eventually. A conductor walked me to the right platform.

dialogues.speaker: Tourist
dialogues.en: People have been kind like that everywhere I've been.
dialogues.ko: 제가 가본 곳마다 사람들이 그렇게 친절하더라고요.

dialogues.speaker: Backpacker
dialogues.en: How much longer are you here for?

dialogues.speaker: Tourist
dialogues.en: Two more days, then I fly home on Saturday.

dialogues.speaker: Backpacker
dialogues.en: That went fast. Are you planning another trip already?
dialogues.ko: 빨리 지나갔네요. 벌써 다음 여행 계획 세우세요?

dialogues.speaker: Tourist
dialogues.en: Always. I think next year I'll try somewhere colder.
dialogues.ko: 늘 그렇죠. 내년엔 좀 더 추운 곳으로 가볼까 해요.

dialogues.speaker: Backpacker
dialogues.en: A few of us are getting dinner tonight. Do you want to come?
dialogues.ko: 오늘 저녁에 몇 명이서 밥 먹으러 가는데, 같이 가실래요?

dialogues.speaker: Tourist
dialogues.en: I'd love to. What time and where?

dialogues.speaker: Backpacker
dialogues.en: Seven, at the place by the bridge. It's a ten-minute walk.

dialogues.speaker: Tourist
dialogues.en: Perfect. I'll meet you in the lobby just before seven.

dialogues.speaker: Backpacker
dialogues.en: Let me get your number so I can send the location.

dialogues.speaker: Tourist
dialogues.en: I'm on a travel SIM, so message me on Instagram instead.

dialogues.speaker: Backpacker
dialogues.en: What's your handle?

dialogues.speaker: Tourist
dialogues.en: It's mina underscore travels, all lowercase.

dialogues.speaker: Backpacker
dialogues.en: I'll send you the photos from today once I'm on wifi.
dialogues.ko: 와이파이 되면 오늘 찍은 사진 보내드릴게요.

dialogues.speaker: Tourist
dialogues.en: Thank you. Could you send the one by the harbour?

dialogues.speaker: Backpacker
dialogues.en: All of them. Tag me if you post any.
dialogues.ko: 전부 보낼게요. 올리시면 저 태그해 주세요.

dialogues.speaker: Tourist
dialogues.en: I will. You got a better shot of the sunset than I did.
dialogues.ko: 그럴게요. 노을 사진은 저보다 잘 찍으셨더라고요.

dialogues.speaker: Backpacker
dialogues.en: It was really good to meet you. Safe travels.
dialogues.ko: 만나서 정말 반가웠어요. 안전한 여행 되세요.

dialogues.speaker: Tourist
dialogues.en: You too. Let me know if you ever come to Korea.

dialogues.speaker: Backpacker
dialogues.en: I might take you up on that next spring.

dialogues.speaker: Tourist
dialogues.en: I'd be happy to show you around. Take care.
